description: Fork of exp336 (40.44 M, val_bpb @ 8K = 1.6475). Single trade: d_v 16 -> 32. Effects: v_lut n_outputs 16 -> 32 (params 4.72 -> 9.43M, +4.72M); qkv_lut n_outputs 2*d_qk+d_v = 144 -> 160 (params 5.31 -> 5.90M, +0.59M); out_proj input dim H*d_v = 96 -> 192 (LUT params unchanged, only anchor sampling). Total model 40.44 -> ~45.7 M. KV cache also doubles for the v half. Tests whether the v stream's expressiveness was a bottleneck at d_v=16 (originally chosen for tiny-LUT bandwidth focus).
